items.title_en: ‘Dodge the police, hold a dharna’: 27-year-old’s Jantar Mantar protest game goes viral
items.title_zh: “躲避警察，举行佛法”：27 岁的 Jantar Mantar 抗议游戏走红
items.summary_en: Called ‘Jantar Mantar Chalo’, the game lets players experience the situation from either side of the barricades, choosing to join the protesters or play as the Delhi Police.
items.summary_zh: 这款游戏名为“Jantar Mantar Chalo”，让玩家从路障两侧体验情况，选择加入抗议者或扮演德里警察。

items.title_en: Law student works for Blinkit, reveals Day 1 earnings: ‘A boon for people like me’
items.title_zh: 在 Blinkit 工作的法学院学生透露第一天的收入：“对像我这样的人来说是一个福音”
items.summary_en: The law student clarified that his LLB remains his primary focus and that he took up delivery work to manage his expenses while continuing his degree.
items.summary_zh: 这位法学院学生澄清说，他的法学学士学位仍然是他的主要关注点，他在继续攻读学位的同时从事送货工作以管理费用。

items.title_en: Zuckerberg reacts to viral Guinness beer-sipping video: ‘That’s just my face’
items.title_zh: 扎克伯格对疯传的吉尼斯啤酒视频做出反应：“这就是我的脸”
items.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg appeared on Irish billionaire John Collison’s Cheeky Pint show alongside Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer, for a conversation over drinks.
items.summary_zh: 马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 出现在爱尔兰亿万富翁约翰·科里森 (John Collison) 的 Cheeky Pint 秀上，与 Meta 的首席人工智能官亚历山大·王 (Alexandr Wang) 一起喝酒聊天。

items.title_en: Ravi Kishan viral memes: Why Karan Johar calls him the ‘king of virality’
items.title_zh: 拉维·基尚（Ravi Kishan）病毒式传播模因：为什么卡兰·乔哈尔（Karan Johar）称他为“病毒式传播之王”
items.summary_en: During the show’s popular Rapid Fire round, actor Karisma Kapoor asked Karan Johar about the Instagram account he follows most closely.
items.summary_zh: 在节目广受欢迎的Rapid Fire 回合中，演员卡里斯玛·卡普尔 (Karisma Kapoor) 向卡兰·乔哈尔 (Karan Johar) 询问了他最关注的 Instagram 帐户。
